authorization.policy: Start the separate compositional bundle alongside IID only with fresh Windows free physical memory at least 1.5 GiB; one CPU thread per process
authorization.reason: Sustained additional host memory headroom allowed overlapping independent frozen evaluations

overlap.semantics: Observed span is the timestamp span between simultaneous-worker snapshots, not an exact worker-lifetime overlap. The upper bound intersects whole-second observed-start to completion-report-write windows. Neither quantity measures simultaneous CPU execution.

scope.excludes: Other host applications, monitoring and report readers

timing_caveat: Shared-host wall times are not isolated benchmark timings. GNU elapsed times remain separate from observed starts and report-write timestamps; validation start is unknown. Timestamp digits describe recorded clock values, not exact event-time precision.
